test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Hawa Mahal’ built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh is situated in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaipur**

 
 
• **Hawa Mahal,** in a real sense the Castle of Winds was constructed involving pink sandstone in 1799 by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh and is the most conspicuous landmark of Jaipur.
 
• The Hawa Mahal is a royal residence in the city of Jaipur, India. Worked from red and pink sandstone.
 
• **In 2006, **remodel deals with the Mahal were embraced, following a hole of 50 years, to give a facelift to the landmark at an expected expense of **Rs 4.568 million.**
 
• Its five-story outside is much the same as a honeycomb with its **953 little windows** called Jharokhas embellished with complicated latticework.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahmedabad **

 
 
• **Ahmed Shah **established the groundwork of Ahmedabad because of which one can see an impression of Mughal Engineering in the landmarks like Jama Masjid,
 
 
 
• Bikaner
 
 
• **Bikaner** is renowned for its flavorful Bikaneri Bhujia all things considered for its desserts.
 
 
 
• Mumbai
 
 
• **Mumbai's most famous mileston**e, the Chhatrapati Shivaji End, is as utilitarian, pertinent and vital to life in the city today as it very well may be just about 130 years after its opening.
 
 
 
• **Jaipur**
 
 
• Royal residences of Jaipur incorporates** Rambagh Castle, City Royal residence, Samode Royal residence, Golden Castle, Hari Mahal Castle, Rajmahal Castle and some more.**
